objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: on the 20 balanced genus-2 first bands on loops of 5 rings (BAND-SURFACE-20261108-001B), every second band in five declared families (every rung subdivided by a new loop; a new loop stacked on one row by single rungs; by double rungs, as a uniform rule; joined to both rows with the old rungs kept, as a uniform rule and a 300,000-case sample), and on the n x 2 tori (n = 3 to 5) a loop stacked by single rungs (every way), joined twice to one row (every way at n = 3; uniform rules and samples at n = 4, 5), and every rung subdivided (every way): which keep every contact persistent, and their genus.
status: Supported 2026-11-08 (exploratory, exact; H1 and H2 hold): of 2,745,424 second bands in the declared families, none keeps a balanced genus-2 first band on a loop of 5 rings balanced, and on the n x 2 tori (n = 3 to 5) the only balanced second band is the torus band rule (genus 1); the 20 genus-2 bases are exactly the first bands with two or three twisted columns.
title: A census of second bands
